'''Haven water''' was native to [[Port Haven/Legends|Port Haven]]. It was ice cold [[Water/Legends|water]] drawn from a bubbling spring and although it tasted like ordinary water, the refreshing and unprocessed taste was favored by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. Some believed that Haven water had medicinal purposes. The water could sell for upwards of forty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the open market.
